_comment: Checked-in license overrides for SwiftPM dependencies, used by generate-notices.py when a dependency's LICENSE file cannot be found under .build/checkouts (for example on a machine that has not built the package graph yet). Each entry gives the SPDX id, a license text URL, and the copyright line to print. licenseUrl must be pinned: write {revision} where the commit goes and generate-notices.py fills in the Package.resolved revision, so the link keeps describing the exact shipped source. A dual-licensed dependency records the license LGE elects in licenseElection. This does not replace fetching the real LICENSE file when it is available -- the script always prefers .build/checkouts when present.
